stem: What is the most likely reason that the author includes a rhetorical question in the title of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To cause readers to feel suspicious about the topic

options.label: B
options.text: To prompt readers to start thinking about their own perspective on the topic

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that readers should spend time researching the topic

options.label: D
options.text: To hint that readers most likely know more about the topic than they think they do
